nodes.name: TypedDmgBoost.ts
nodes.summary: Calculates per-damage-type damage multipliers and heal multipliers from active buffs and perks (e.g., Glyph Conduit for magic, Rage for physical/magic/water, Photosynthesis for holy/earth in sunlight). Aggregates into a dmgMultByType map.

functions.name: calcTypedDmgBoosts
functions.summary: Computes per-type damage multipliers and a global heal multiplier by evaluating all typed damage boost definitions against active perks, buffs, and context (sunlight, draconic color).

nodes.name: Weaponartcheck.ts
nodes.summary: Validates whether a weapon art's requirements (scaling, stats, weapon type, guild, both-parts) are met by the current build, and produces human-readable lists of unmet requirements.

functions.name: checkWA
functions.summary: Returns true if the weapon art's requirements (guild, weapon type, scaling, stats, both-parts) are fully satisfied by the build.

functions.name: getUnmetReqs
functions.summary: Returns an array of human-readable strings describing which weapon art requirements are not met.

nodes.name: weaponArts.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the WeaponArt and WeaponArtRequirement interfaces and the WEAPON_ARTS data array containing all weapon art definitions with their names, descriptions, cooldowns, damage, scaling, hits, and requirements.

nodes.name: damage-types.ts
nodes.summary: Defines all damage type metadata (labels, colors), defense inheritance mappings, type priority ordering, and exported constant arrays for the game's 11 damage types (physical, magic, fire, water, earth, air, hex, holy, true, summon, heal).

nodes.name: damageTypeResolve.ts
nodes.summary: Resolves weapon art damage types from string descriptions into numeric type maps, applies type bonuses, and performs damage type conversions (Fire<->Air via Echo Incineration, Air->Magic via Spirit Winds, Dark Magic hex bonus).

functions.name: resolveDamageTypes
functions.summary: Merges base damage types with bonus damage types by summing corresponding keys.

functions.name: applyFireAirConversion
functions.summary: Converts 50% of Fire damage to Air and 50% of Air damage to Fire (Echo Incineration).

functions.name: resolveWaDamageTypeKeys
functions.summary: Parses a weapon art's damage type string ('Same as weapon', 'Highest damage type', or explicit multi-type) into a numeric type map.

functions.name: getFinalWaDmgTypes
functions.summary: Combines resolveWaDamageTypeKeys with resolveDamageTypes to produce the final weapon art damage type distribution.

functions.name: applyAirToMagicConversion
functions.summary: Converts a fraction of Air to Magic (Spirit Winds), then applies Fire<->Air conversion (Echo Incineration), then adds Dark Magic hex bonus from native magic.

nodes.name: _utils.ts
nodes.summary: Minimal utility module exporting round2 and round4 functions for numeric rounding with epsilon correction, used throughout the engine layer.

functions.name: round2
functions.summary: Rounds a number to 2 decimal places with epsilon correction.

functions.name: round4
functions.summary: Rounds a number to 4 decimal places with epsilon correction.

nodes.name: build.ts
nodes.summary: Core build calculation engine: accumulates stats and perks from all equipment slots (race, guild, armor, ring, rune, weapon), applies enchantments and infusions, finalizes perks with effectiveness scaling, computes CDR, boosts, crit, and assembles active buffs. Exports calcBuild as the main entry point.

functions.name: calcBuild
functions.summary: Main entry point: accumulates equipment stats/perks, finalizes perks, and derives the full BuildResult with boosted stats, CDR, boosts, and crit.

nodes.name: data.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel re-export module that re-exports all symbols from character, equipment, and weapon data sub-modules, providing a single import point for game data accessors.

nodes.name: enchant.ts
nodes.summary: Enchantment application engine: applies stat-selecting enchantments (Restored, Flawless), direct stat modifiers, perk modifiers, perk effectiveness scaling, infusion (50% stat halving), and exclusive enchant slot enforcement.

functions.name: applyEnchantmentsToSlot
functions.summary: Applies a list of enchantments to an equipment slot's base stats and perks, handling stat selectors, direct modifiers, perk modifiers, and upgrade levels.

functions.name: applyPerkEffectiveness
functions.summary: Scales all perks by (1 + PE * 0.1) * (1 + Cursed * 0.1), exempting enchant effects and certain special perks.

functions.name: applyInfusion
functions.summary: Halves all stats from an infused item (50% stat value) while keeping perks unchanged.

functions.name: isExclusiveEnchant
functions.summary: Returns true if the enchantment has stacking='exclusive' (takes over entire slot).

functions.name: enforceEnchantSlot
functions.summary: Enforces slot constraints: deduplicates, handles exclusive enchants, and compacts filled slots.

nodes.name: format.ts
nodes.summary: Formatting utilities for stat display: formats numeric stat values with +/- signs, percentage suffixes for percent-type stats, and converts camelCase stat keys to readable labels.

functions.name: formatStat
functions.summary: Formats a stat value with +/- sign and % suffix for percent-type stats.

functions.name: formatLabel
functions.summary: Converts a camelCase stat key to a readable label (e.g., 'attackSpeed' -> 'Attack Speed').

nodes.name: shrine.ts
nodes.summary: Shrine multiplier system: defines tier-based stat multipliers (3.0x at tier 1 down to 1.0x at tier 5) and applies them to weapon stats and scalings when the shrine is active.

functions.name: applyShrineToScalings
functions.summary: Multiplies all scaling values by the shrine tier multiplier.

functions.name: applyShrineToStats
functions.summary: Multiplies all stat values by the shrine tier multiplier with rounding.

nodes.name: weapon.ts
nodes.summary: Weapon calculation engine: combines blade/handle (or glove/essence for monk) stats, scalings, damage types, and perks; resolves weapon type from handle+blade combo with perk overrides; detects hybrid bonus; applies shrine multipliers and monk rank bonuses. Exports calcWeapon and calcMonkWeapon.

functions.name: calcWeapon
functions.summary: Calculates the full WeaponResult for a standard (non-monk) weapon from blade and handle names, including merged stats, scalings, damage types, weapon type resolution, and hybrid detection.

functions.name: calcMonkWeapon
functions.summary: Calculates the full WeaponResult for a monk weapon from glove and essence names, applying monk rank stat bonuses on top of shrine-scaled stats.

nodes.label: Boost.ts
nodes.description: Defines the damage boost calculation system for the Voxel Blade build calculator. Contains BoostDef/BoostContext interfaces and a comprehensive BOOST_DEFS array of 30+ damage boosts (Blood Thirsty, Frenzy, Primal, Penance, Vampire, etc.), each with either simple multiplier-per-perk values or complex custom calcFn closures. Also exports helper functions calcMinionAbsorptionPotency and calcFrenzyPct, and Penance bleed constants.

nodes.label: debuffCombatEffects.ts
nodes.description: Defines the combat effects applied by debuffs on enemies. Exports a DEBUFF_COMBAT_EFFECTS record mapping debuff names (Weakness, Shatter, Sticky variants, Electrical Rend, Despair, Frostbite, Hypnotized) to DebuffCombatEffect objects containing description generators, damage multipliers, defense reductions, and element-specific damage multipliers.

nodes.label: enemyHpEffects.ts
nodes.description: Defines HP-gated enemy effects that trigger based on enemy current HP percentage. Contains interfaces for HP gates, debuff effects, and DoT boosts, plus a static ENEMY_HP_EFFECT_DEFS array (currently Mycotic Bloom). Exports functions getActiveEnemyHpDebuffs and getEnemyHpDotMultiplier to evaluate which effects are active given the current enemy HP and active debuffs.

nodes.label: perkAutoDebuffs.ts
nodes.description: Determines which debuffs are automatically applied by perks during combat. Contains calcActualHpFillPct for effective HP calculation accounting for protection, and getAutoDebuffs which evaluates 16+ perk conditions (Exhaust, Penance, Melting Shred, Fungal Prototype, Venom Spitter, Toxin Caster, Gorecast, Splinter, Bellowing Ember, Frostbite, Gelid Lance, Weakening, Sunburn, Fiery Pursuit, Pyre Bloom, Hypnotist) to produce GrantedBuff arrays.

nodes.label: debuff-effects.ts
nodes.description: Small constants file defining numeric multipliers used by debuff combat effects. Contains the Sticky damage multiplier (1.2x), Despair display divisor/coefficient for UI formatting, and Despair damage coefficient (0.085).

nodes.label: game.ts
nodes.description: Core game constants serving as the single source of truth for game-wide values. Defines level caps (MAX_LEVEL=80, DEFAULT_LEVEL=80), HP formula constants (BASE_HP=120, HP_PER_LEVEL=0.0125) with calcBaseMaxHP function, default fill percentages, and timing constants for UI operations (save debounce, undo window, search blur delay, toast duration, etc.).

nodes.label: perk-base-damage.ts
nodes.description: Contains raw numeric base damage values for all perk-triggered abilities, weapon arts, and spirit summons. Organized by ability name (Dragon Claw, Dragon Bubble, Springblast, various Spirits, Honey Arts, Melting Slime, Pyre Bloom, Bastion Ballista, etc.). Each ability has base damage, per-stack scaling, and optionally special properties (healing, poise damage, duration, ammo, cooldown).

nodes.label: perks.ts
nodes.description: Contains perk-specific numeric constants used across the damage engine. Covers crit base values (BASE_CRIT_DAMAGE=150), crit rate multipliers for various perks (Flowing Crits, Spell Slinger, Sharp Crits, etc.), crit damage formulas (Thief Training, Venom Eater, Vital Strikes, etc.), element multipliers (Luminescent, Spirit Winds, Dark Magic, etc.), and combat mechanic values (Sunburn, Frostbite, Fiery Pursuit, Hypnotist, Phantom Pain).

nodes.label: storage.ts
nodes.description: Defines localStorage keys and serialization mappings for build state persistence. Contains STORAGE_KEY_* constants for each saved data category, BUILD_STATE_DEFAULTS record with all default build values, SAVE_KEY_MAP/UNMAP for compact save serialization, and ENCH_MAP/UNMAP for enchantment serialization. Also defines MAX_BUILD_SLOTS (5) and CONFIRM_TIMEOUT_MS.

nodes.label: dmgTypeBonuses.ts
nodes.description: Engine module that calculates elemental/magical damage type bonuses from perks. Defines PerkDmgTypeBonusDef interface and PERK_DMG_TYPE_BONUS_DEFS array (Void Rage Ä‚Â¢Ã¢â‚¬Â Ã¢â‚¬â„¢ hex, Channeled Weapon Ä‚Â¢Ã¢â‚¬Â Ã¢â‚¬â„¢ magic, Emotional Ä‚Â¢Ã¢â‚¬Â Ã¢â‚¬â„¢ fire, Draconic Blood Ä‚Â¢Ã¢â‚¬Â Ã¢â‚¬â„¢ dynamic based on draconic color). The buildDmgTypeBonuses function evaluates all definitions against current player state and returns a Record<string, number> of damage type to bonus percentage, also accounting for Toxin Transfer hex bonus.

nodes.label: weaponConditionalBoosts.ts
nodes.description: Defines conditional damage boosts applied to specific weapon types when matching perks and hit scopes (M1 finisher or M2). Iterates over a static list of boost definitions and accumulates a combined multiplier.

nodes.label: crit.ts
nodes.description: Core critical hit calculation engine. Computes natural crit chance, extra crit chance, combined effective crit chance, and crit damage multiplier from stats and perks. Handles Primal division, proc coefficient scaling, and sources for both crit chance and crit damage.

nodes.label: defense.ts
nodes.description: Defense calculation module. Resolves defense sources (percent-based and flat) into damage multipliers, groups damage types by which defense stats apply, and computes total base armor defense percentage.

nodes.label: utils.ts
nodes.description: Shared utility functions used across the calculation engine and UI. Provides multiplier rounding, warding debuff multiplier calculation, text highlighting for search, and proc chance computation with different scaling modes.

nodes.label: rings.json

nodes.label: runes.json

nodes.label: app.css

nodes.label: BaseDamageCalc.svelte
nodes.description: Component (2660 lines) that computes and displays base damage breakdowns for each attack type (M1/M2/WA). Handles damage type resolution, defense calculations, critical hit display, armor penetration, perk on-hit damage, and status effect damage. Central to the damage output visualization.

nodes.label: CdrStepsCalc.svelte
nodes.description: Small component (92 lines) displaying a step-by-step cooldown reduction calculation. Shows each CDR source as a multiply/divide operation with animated arrow transitions from base cooldown to final value with floor and minimum cap display.

nodes.label: CritIcon.svelte
nodes.description: Simple SVG icon component (13 lines) rendering a critical hit symbol. Uses a gradient fill from red to orange for the starburst shape.

nodes.label: draconicRunes.ts
nodes.description: Module (104 lines) computing draconic rune and draconic infusion bonuses to damage types. Provides applyDraconicBonuses and getDraconicBonuses functions that add elemental damage bonuses based on rune stacks and infusion state.

nodes.label: selfDamagePerks.ts
nodes.description: Module (82 lines) defining perks that deal self-damage (Undead Might, Explosive Charge, Dark Magic, Bombardier). Each definition specifies the damage fraction, damage type distribution, DR reduction per stack, and affected attack types. Includes calcSelfDamage function with harmonic-series multi-target falloff.

nodes.label: stanceOverlays.ts
nodes.description: Module (59 lines) resolving stance overlay types based on weapon configuration. Checks Blaster Ring, Locked And Loaded, Cosmic Ray, and Mine conditions against weapon perks and fist/weapon type to determine Rifle/Shotgun/Dual Guns/Side Gun overlay styles.

nodes.label: DidYouMean.svelte
nodes.description: Component (110 lines) showing fuzzy search suggestions when no exact results are found. Displays clickable chips with highlighted text matching for name and perk search results.

nodes.label: DmgTotalTooltip.svelte
nodes.description: Component (169 lines) displaying a tooltip with damage breakdown by type. Groups ComputedHit entries by damage type, shows animated pie chart visualization, and lists per-type totals with percentage bars.

nodes.label: DraconicAbilityStats.svelte
nodes.description: Small component (42 lines) displaying draconic ability stat rows: damage type, scaling, poise damage, and optional holy/water heal values.

nodes.label: EmotionalTracker.svelte
nodes.description: Component (231 lines) managing the Emotional state selector (Buffs only / Debuffs only / Both). Provides a 3-position slider with color-coded states that persists to the build store.

nodes.label: Highlight.svelte
nodes.description: Simple component (16 lines) rendering text with search-term highlighting. Wraps highlighted portions in <mark> tags using highlightTextParts utility.

nodes.label: LevelBar.svelte
nodes.description: Component (398 lines) displaying and editing the character level and HP bar. Features draggable fill indicator, shield HP overlay, protection stat display, editable level input with keyboard shortcuts, and responsive styling.

nodes.label: boosts.ts

Contains ~55 exported numeric constants for per-stack multipliers (Blood Thirsty, Venom Spitter, Perfection, etc.) and complex boost parameters (Heat Drill cooldown/damage, Quickdraw, Spring Powered, etc.).

nodes.label: cdr.ts

nodes.label: defensive.ts
nodes.description: Constants module (22 lines) defining defensive perk DR values: Barbskin, Stoneskin, Adaptive Plate, Protector Spirit, Air Pressure, Valor, Vampire, Frenzy, Stored Corruption, Mounted Defense, Carapace, and Cursed Bark.

nodes.label: draconic-colors.ts
nodes.description: Constants module (20 lines) defining draconic color multiplier values for Fire, Air, Earth, Water, and Hex dragon states: speed, damage, stun, knockback, and cooldown multipliers.

nodes.label: draconic.ts
nodes.description: Constants module (10 lines) defining draconic infusion potency/duration multipliers and dragon state HP/damage parameters.

nodes.description: Constants module (5 lines) defining critical healing base value, holy boost divisor, per-stack healing bonus, and Ocean Song per-stack heal percentage.

nodes.label: thresholds.ts

nodes.label: Panel.svelte
nodes.description: Panel container UI component (94 lines) with collapsible header, glass morphism styling, and slot-based content area.

nodes.label: Section.svelte
nodes.description: Section container UI component (129 lines) with title, description, and content slots for organizing related UI elements.

nodes.label: Stat.svelte
nodes.description: Reusable stat display UI component (90 lines) using Svelte 5 runes ($props). Renders a label-value pair with variant colors (green/amber/red/purple/blue/teal) and sizes (sm/md/lg). Supports children snippets for custom value rendering.

nodes.label: uiConstants.ts
nodes.description: UI constants module (78 lines) defining UI_COLORS (damage type colors, tag group colors, source type colors, enchant rarity colors, negative stat colors), SOURCE_LABELS, STAT_LABELS, and TAG_LABELS mappings used across the UI.

nodes.label: main.ts
nodes.description: Application entry point (8 lines). Imports and mounts the App.svelte component, imports global CSS, and initializes Vercel analytics.

nodes.label: ModalSearchHeader.svelte
nodes.description: Component (199 lines) providing a reusable search header for modal dialogs. Includes search input, suggestion dropdown, tag filter, stat filter (weapon or standard), and optional sort buttons. Used by AccessorySelectModal and WeaponPartModal.

nodes.label: MountIcon.svelte
nodes.description: SVG icon component (64 lines) rendering a detailed mount icon with gradient fill. Contains complex SVG path data for the mount silhouette.

nodes.label: ScalingBreakdownRow.svelte
nodes.description: Component (102 lines) displaying a single weapon scaling breakdown row. Shows stat name, base value, multiplier arrow, scaled value, boost percentage, and effective contribution in a grid layout.

nodes.label: StatFilter.svelte
nodes.description: Component (334 lines) providing stat-based filtering for equipment selection. Groups stats into Boost/Defense/Speed categories with include/exclude toggle chips. Supports sort modes: highest, lowest, alphabetical, most-effective, brawny.

nodes.label: SuggestDrop.svelte
nodes.description: Component (67 lines) rendering a dropdown of search suggestions. Displays items with type labels (Name/Perk) and highlighted text matching the search query.

nodes.label: TagFilter.svelte
nodes.description: Component (330 lines) providing tag-based filtering for perk/weapon selection. Groups tags into Combat/Support/Status/Weapon Art-Rune/Special categories with toggle chips. Supports hiding specific tags and excluding tags from the filter.

nodes.label: WeaponStatFilter.svelte
nodes.description: Component (240 lines) providing weapon-specific stat filtering. Similar to StatFilter but specialized for weapon part selection with damage scaling and attack speed focus.

nodes.label: WeaponStatsDisplay.svelte
nodes.description: Component (121 lines) displaying computed weapon stats in a compact panel. Shows damage, attack speed, and scaling values with color-coded labels.

nodes.label: vite.config.ts
nodes.description: Vite build configuration (59 lines). Configures Svelte plugin, VitePWA for PWA support with auto-update and StaleWhileRevalidate caching, and rollup-plugin-visualizer for bundle analysis. Uses configurable base path via VITE_BASE_PATH env var.
